body.name: Branch-indexed switching acquisition certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\)
body.construction:
A branch-indexed switching certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\) is a lexicographically ordered finite list of switching records.  The nonempty ownership masks \(K(R)\) partition \(\Omega\).  For every nonempty record, its decoded \(S\) lies in \(\Pi\), \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}(S)\) returns a law handle and exact support table, \(\ell\) names a positive well-typed slice, \(T\) is one measured-ancestry single-district source factor extracted from that slice, and every \(\tau_{\alpha}\) succeeds for its owned concrete branch \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\).  A record may have empty ownership only as a paid-protocol marker; then the fixed-width label and source masks are the designated all-zero sentinels, the transcript list is empty, and it contributes no element to \(\mathcal R(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\).  Records sharing a protocol pay its cost once.  The exact encoding length is
\[
 N_{\mathrm{sw}}=\sum_{R\in E_{\mathrm{sw}}}
 \left(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+M+|V|(1+|\mathrm{LIT}|)
       +\sum_{\alpha\in K(R)}|\operatorname{enc}(\tau_{\alpha})|\right).
\]
No record is required to use one source or transcript uniformly across two different branches.
